title: A tilted oval: tangent lines and a moving point

stimulus.title: The curve <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>−</mo><mi>x</mi><mi>y</mi><mo>+</mo><msup><mi>y</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mn>2</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><mi>y</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>2</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">x^2 - xy + y^2 + 2x - y = 2</annotation></semantics></math>

parts.label: a

rubric.point: Implicit differentiation of both sides, with the product rule on <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>x</mi><mi>y</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">xy</annotation></semantics></math>: <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mn>2</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><mrow><mo fence="true" stretchy="true">(</mo><mrow><mi>y</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>x</mi><mfrac><mrow><mi>d</mi><mi>y</mi></mrow><mrow><mi>d</mi><mi>x</mi></mrow></mfrac></mrow><mo fence="true" stretchy="true">)</mo></mrow><mo>+</mo><mn>2</mn><mi>y</mi><mfrac><mrow><mi>d</mi><mi>y</mi></mrow><mrow><mi>d</mi><mi>x</mi></mrow></mfrac><mo>+</mo><mn>2</mn><mo>−</mo><mfrac><mrow><mi>d</mi><mi>y</mi></mrow><mrow><mi>d</mi><mi>x</mi></mrow></mfrac></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">2x - \left(y + x\frac{dy}{dx}\right) + 2y\frac{dy}{dx} + 2 - \frac{dy}{dx}</annotation></semantics></math> <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">= 0</annotation></semantics></math>
accept: any equivalent equation that differentiates every term, including the product rule on <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>x</mi><mi>y</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">xy</annotation></semantics></math>, and keeps <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">= 0</annotation></semantics></math>
an error in exactly one term earns no point

rubric.point: Collects the <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mfrac><mrow><mi>d</mi><mi>y</mi></mrow><mrow><mi>d</mi><mi>x</mi></mrow></mfrac></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\frac{dy}{dx}</annotation></semantics></math> terms and solves to reach the given expression
accept: <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mfrac><mrow><mi>d</mi><mi>y</mi></mrow><mrow><mi>d</mi><mi>x</mi></mrow></mfrac><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>2</mn><mi>y</mi><mo>−</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>1</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\frac{dy}{dx}(2y - x - 1)</annotation></semantics></math> <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mo>=</mo><mi>y</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>2</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>2</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">= y - 2x - 2</annotation></semantics></math>, then division
the verification must follow from correct work; it cannot be earned from the given answer alone

parts.sample: <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mfrac><mi>d</mi><mrow><mi>d</mi><mi>x</mi></mrow></mfrac><mrow><mo fence="true" stretchy="true">(</mo><mrow><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>−</mo><mi>x</mi><mi>y</mi><mo>+</mo><msup><mi>y</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mn>2</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><mi>y</mi></mrow><mo fence="true" stretchy="true">)</mo></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\frac{d}{dx}\left(x^2 - xy + y^2 + 2x - y\right)</annotation></semantics></math> <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mi>d</mi><mrow><mi>d</mi><mi>x</mi></mrow></mfrac><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>2</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">= \frac{d}{dx}(2)</annotation></semantics></math> gives <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mn>2</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><mi>y</mi><mo>−</mo><mi>x</mi><mfrac><mrow><mi>d</mi><mi>y</mi></mrow><mrow><mi>d</mi><mi>x</mi></mrow></mfrac><mo>+</mo><mn>2</mn><mi>y</mi><mfrac><mrow><mi>d</mi><mi>y</mi></mrow><mrow><mi>d</mi><mi>x</mi></mrow></mfrac><mo>+</mo><mn>2</mn><mo>−</mo><mfrac><mrow><mi>d</mi><mi>y</mi></mrow><mrow><mi>d</mi><mi>x</mi></mrow></mfrac></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">2x - y - x\frac{dy}{dx} + 2y\frac{dy}{dx} + 2 - \frac{dy}{dx}</annotation></semantics></math> <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">= 0</annotation></semantics></math>. So <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mfrac><mrow><mi>d</mi><mi>y</mi></mrow><mrow><mi>d</mi><mi>x</mi></mrow></mfrac><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>2</mn><mi>y</mi><mo>−</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>1</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\frac{dy}{dx}(2y - x - 1)</annotation></semantics></math> <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mo>=</mo><mi>y</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>2</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>2</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">= y - 2x - 2</annotation></semantics></math>, and <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mfrac><mrow><mi>d</mi><mi>y</mi></mrow><mrow><mi>d</mi><mi>x</mi></mrow></mfrac></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\frac{dy}{dx}</annotation></semantics></math> <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mrow><mi>y</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>2</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>2</mn></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn><mi>y</mi><mo>−</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></mfrac></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">= \frac{y - 2x - 2}{2y - x - 1}</annotation></semantics></math>.

parts.label: b
parts.prompt: Write an equation for the line tangent to the curve at the point (0,−1)(0, -1).

rubric.point: Slope at <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>0</mn><mo>,</mo><mo form="prefix" lspace="0" rspace="0">−</mo><mn>1</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">(0, -1)</annotation></semantics></math> and the tangent line: <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>y</mi><mo>=</mo><mo form="prefix" lspace="0" rspace="0">−</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>+</mo><mn>1</mn><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>0</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">y = -1 + 1(x - 0)</annotation></semantics></math>
accept: <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><msub><mrow><mfrac><mrow><mi>d</mi><mi>y</mi></mrow><mrow><mi>d</mi><mi>x</mi></mrow></mfrac><mo fence="true" stretchy="true">|</mo></mrow><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>0</mn><mo>,</mo><mo form="prefix" lspace="0" rspace="0">−</mo><mn>1</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></msub></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\left.\frac{dy}{dx}\right|_{(0, -1)}</annotation></semantics></math> <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mrow><mo form="prefix" lspace="0" rspace="0">−</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>−</mo><mn>0</mn><mo>−</mo><mn>2</mn></mrow><mrow><mo form="prefix" lspace="0" rspace="0">−</mo><mn>2</mn><mo>−</mo><mn>0</mn><mo>−</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></mfrac></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">= \frac{-1 - 0 - 2}{-2 - 0 - 1}</annotation></semantics></math> <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">= 1</annotation></semantics></math>, then <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>y</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>=</mo><mi>x</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">y + 1 = x</annotation></semantics></math>

parts.sample: At <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>0</mn><mo>,</mo><mo form="prefix" lspace="0" rspace="0">−</mo><mn>1</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">(0, -1)</annotation></semantics></math>: <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mfrac><mrow><mi>d</mi><mi>y</mi></mrow><mrow><mi>d</mi><mi>x</mi></mrow></mfrac></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\frac{dy}{dx}</annotation></semantics></math> <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mrow><mo form="prefix" lspace="0" rspace="0">−</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>−</mo><mn>0</mn><mo>−</mo><mn>2</mn></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mo form="prefix" lspace="0" rspace="0">−</mo><mn>1</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>−</mo><mn>0</mn><mo>−</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></mfrac></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">= \frac{-1 - 0 - 2}{2(-1) - 0 - 1}</annotation></semantics></math> <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mrow><mo form="prefix" lspace="0" rspace="0">−</mo><mn>3</mn></mrow><mrow><mo form="prefix" lspace="0" rspace="0">−</mo><mn>3</mn></mrow></mfrac></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">= \frac{-3}{-3}</annotation></semantics></math> <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">= 1</annotation></semantics></math>. The tangent line is <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>y</mi><mo>=</mo><mo form="prefix" lspace="0" rspace="0">−</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>+</mo><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>0</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">y = -1 + (x - 0)</annotation></semantics></math>, that is <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>y</mi><mo>=</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">y = x - 1</annotation></semantics></math>.

parts.label: c
parts.prompt: Find the coordinates of all points on the curve at which the line tangent to the curve is horizontal.

rubric.point: Sets the numerator equal to 0: <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>y</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>2</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>2</mn><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">y - 2x - 2 = 0</annotation></semantics></math>, so <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>y</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>2</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>2</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">y = 2x + 2</annotation></semantics></math>

Substitutes <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>y</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>2</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>2</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">y = 2x + 2</annotation></semantics></math> into the equation of the curve and solves: <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mn>3</mn><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mn>6</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">3x^2 + 6x = 0</annotation></semantics></math>, so <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>x</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">x = 0</annotation></semantics></math> or <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>x</mi><mo>=</mo><mo form="prefix" lspace="0" rspace="0">−</mo><mn>2</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">x = -2</annotation></semantics></math>
accept: any correct algebra leading to <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>x</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">x = 0</annotation></semantics></math> and <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>x</mi><mo>=</mo><mo form="prefix" lspace="0" rspace="0">−</mo><mn>2</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">x = -2</annotation></semantics></math>

rubric.point: Answer <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>0</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>2</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">(0, 2)</annotation></semantics></math> and <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mo form="prefix" lspace="0" rspace="0">−</mo><mn>2</mn><mo>,</mo><mo form="prefix" lspace="0" rspace="0">−</mo><mn>2</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">(-2, -2)</annotation></semantics></math>, with the denominator checked to be nonzero at both
accept: <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mn>2</mn><mi>y</mi><mo>−</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>=</mo><mn>3</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">2y - x - 1 = 3</annotation></semantics></math> at <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>0</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>2</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">(0, 2)</annotation></semantics></math> and <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mo form="prefix" lspace="0" rspace="0">−</mo><mn>3</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">-3</annotation></semantics></math> at <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mo form="prefix" lspace="0" rspace="0">−</mo><mn>2</mn><mo>,</mo><mo form="prefix" lspace="0" rspace="0">−</mo><mn>2</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">(-2, -2)</annotation></semantics></math>

parts.sample: <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mfrac><mrow><mi>d</mi><mi>y</mi></mrow><mrow><mi>d</mi><mi>x</mi></mrow></mfrac><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\frac{dy}{dx} = 0</annotation></semantics></math> needs <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>y</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>2</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>2</mn><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">y - 2x - 2 = 0</annotation></semantics></math>, so <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>y</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>2</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>2</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">y = 2x + 2</annotation></semantics></math>. Substituting: <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>−</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>2</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>2</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>+</mo><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>2</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>2</mn><msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mn>2</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>2</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>2</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">x^2 - x(2x + 2) + (2x + 2)^2 + 2x - (2x + 2)</annotation></semantics></math> <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mo>=</mo><mn>2</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">= 2</annotation></semantics></math>, which simplifies to <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mn>3</mn><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mn>6</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>2</mn><mo>=</mo><mn>2</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">3x^2 + 6x + 2 = 2</annotation></semantics></math>, so <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mn>3</mn><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>2</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">3x(x + 2) = 0</annotation></semantics></math> and <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>x</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">x = 0</annotation></semantics></math> or <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>x</mi><mo>=</mo><mo form="prefix" lspace="0" rspace="0">−</mo><mn>2</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">x = -2</annotation></semantics></math>. The points are <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>0</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>2</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">(0, 2)</annotation></semantics></math> and <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mo form="prefix" lspace="0" rspace="0">−</mo><mn>2</mn><mo>,</mo><mo form="prefix" lspace="0" rspace="0">−</mo><mn>2</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">(-2, -2)</annotation></semantics></math>. There the denominator <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mn>2</mn><mi>y</mi><mo>−</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">2y - x - 1</annotation></semantics></math> equals <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mn>3</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">3</annotation></semantics></math> and <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mo form="prefix" lspace="0" rspace="0">−</mo><mn>3</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">-3</annotation></semantics></math>, not 0, so the tangent lines are horizontal at <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>0</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>2</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">(0, 2)</annotation></semantics></math> and <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mo form="prefix" lspace="0" rspace="0">−</mo><mn>2</mn><mo>,</mo><mo form="prefix" lspace="0" rspace="0">−</mo><mn>2</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">(-2, -2)</annotation></semantics></math>.

parts.label: d
parts.prompt: A particle moves along the curve. At the instant the particle passes through the point (1,1)(1, 1), dydt=3\frac{dy}{dt} = 3. Find dxdt\frac{dx}{dt} at that instant. Explain what your answer shows about the tangent line at (1,1)(1, 1).

rubric.point: Differentiates the equation of the curve with respect to <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>t</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">t</annotation></semantics></math>: <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mn>2</mn><mi>x</mi><mfrac><mrow><mi>d</mi><mi>x</mi></mrow><mrow><mi>d</mi><mi>t</mi></mrow></mfrac><mo>−</mo><mrow><mo fence="true" stretchy="true">(</mo><mrow><mfrac><mrow><mi>d</mi><mi>x</mi></mrow><mrow><mi>d</mi><mi>t</mi></mrow></mfrac><mi>y</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>x</mi><mfrac><mrow><mi>d</mi><mi>y</mi></mrow><mrow><mi>d</mi><mi>t</mi></mrow></mfrac></mrow><mo fence="true" stretchy="true">)</mo></mrow><mo>+</mo><mn>2</mn><mi>y</mi><mfrac><mrow><mi>d</mi><mi>y</mi></mrow><mrow><mi>d</mi><mi>t</mi></mrow></mfrac><mo>+</mo><mn>2</mn><mfrac><mrow><mi>d</mi><mi>x</mi></mrow><mrow><mi>d</mi><mi>t</mi></mrow></mfrac><mo>−</mo><mfrac><mrow><mi>d</mi><mi>y</mi></mrow><mrow><mi>d</mi><mi>t</mi></mrow></mfrac></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">2x\frac{dx}{dt} - \left(\frac{dx}{dt}y + x\frac{dy}{dt}\right) + 2y\frac{dy}{dt} + 2\frac{dx}{dt} - \frac{dy}{dt}</annotation></semantics></math> <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">= 0</annotation></semantics></math>
accept: or uses <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mfrac><mrow><mi>d</mi><mi>y</mi></mrow><mrow><mi>d</mi><mi>t</mi></mrow></mfrac><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mrow><mi>d</mi><mi>y</mi></mrow><mrow><mi>d</mi><mi>x</mi></mrow></mfrac><mo>⋅</mo><mfrac><mrow><mi>d</mi><mi>x</mi></mrow><mrow><mi>d</mi><mi>t</mi></mrow></mfrac></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\frac{dy}{dt} = \frac{dy}{dx} \cdot \frac{dx}{dt}</annotation></semantics></math> with a correct reason why it cannot be solved for <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mfrac><mrow><mi>d</mi><mi>x</mi></mrow><mrow><mi>d</mi><mi>t</mi></mrow></mfrac></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\frac{dx}{dt}</annotation></semantics></math> directly at <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>1</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">(1, 1)</annotation></semantics></math>

the <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mfrac><mrow><mi>d</mi><mi>y</mi></mrow><mrow><mi>d</mi><mi>t</mi></mrow></mfrac></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\frac{dy}{dt}</annotation></semantics></math> terms cancel: <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mo form="prefix" lspace="0" rspace="0">−</mo><mn>3</mn><mo>+</mo><mn>6</mn><mo>−</mo><mn>3</mn><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">-3 + 6 - 3 = 0</annotation></semantics></math>

rubric.point: Answer <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mfrac><mrow><mi>d</mi><mi>x</mi></mrow><mrow><mi>d</mi><mi>t</mi></mrow></mfrac><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\frac{dx}{dt} = 0</annotation></semantics></math>, with the explanation that the tangent line at <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>1</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">(1, 1)</annotation></semantics></math> is vertical
accept: at <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>1</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">(1, 1)</annotation></semantics></math> the denominator <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mn>2</mn><mi>y</mi><mo>−</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">2y - x - 1 = 0</annotation></semantics></math> while the numerator is <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mo form="prefix" lspace="0" rspace="0">−</mo><mn>3</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">-3</annotation></semantics></math>, so the tangent line is vertical and the particle momentarily moves straight up

parts.sample: Differentiate with respect to <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>t</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">t</annotation></semantics></math>: <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mn>2</mn><mi>x</mi><mfrac><mrow><mi>d</mi><mi>x</mi></mrow><mrow><mi>d</mi><mi>t</mi></mrow></mfrac><mo>−</mo><mfrac><mrow><mi>d</mi><mi>x</mi></mrow><mrow><mi>d</mi><mi>t</mi></mrow></mfrac><mi>y</mi><mo>−</mo><mi>x</mi><mfrac><mrow><mi>d</mi><mi>y</mi></mrow><mrow><mi>d</mi><mi>t</mi></mrow></mfrac><mo>+</mo><mn>2</mn><mi>y</mi><mfrac><mrow><mi>d</mi><mi>y</mi></mrow><mrow><mi>d</mi><mi>t</mi></mrow></mfrac><mo>+</mo><mn>2</mn><mfrac><mrow><mi>d</mi><mi>x</mi></mrow><mrow><mi>d</mi><mi>t</mi></mrow></mfrac><mo>−</mo><mfrac><mrow><mi>d</mi><mi>y</mi></mrow><mrow><mi>d</mi><mi>t</mi></mrow></mfrac></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">2x\frac{dx}{dt} - \frac{dx}{dt}y - x\frac{dy}{dt} + 2y\frac{dy}{dt} + 2\frac{dx}{dt} - \frac{dy}{dt}</annotation></semantics></math> <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">= 0</annotation></semantics></math>. At <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>1</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">(1, 1)</annotation></semantics></math> with <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mfrac><mrow><mi>d</mi><mi>y</mi></mrow><mrow><mi>d</mi><mi>t</mi></mrow></mfrac><mo>=</mo><mn>3</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\frac{dy}{dt} = 3</annotation></semantics></math>: <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mn>2</mn><mfrac><mrow><mi>d</mi><mi>x</mi></mrow><mrow><mi>d</mi><mi>t</mi></mrow></mfrac><mo>−</mo><mfrac><mrow><mi>d</mi><mi>x</mi></mrow><mrow><mi>d</mi><mi>t</mi></mrow></mfrac><mo>−</mo><mn>3</mn><mo>+</mo><mn>6</mn><mo>+</mo><mn>2</mn><mfrac><mrow><mi>d</mi><mi>x</mi></mrow><mrow><mi>d</mi><mi>t</mi></mrow></mfrac><mo>−</mo><mn>3</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">2\frac{dx}{dt} - \frac{dx}{dt} - 3 + 6 + 2\frac{dx}{dt} - 3</annotation></semantics></math> <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">= 0</annotation></semantics></math>, so <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mn>3</mn><mfrac><mrow><mi>d</mi><mi>x</mi></mrow><mrow><mi>d</mi><mi>t</mi></mrow></mfrac><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">3\frac{dx}{dt} = 0</annotation></semantics></math> and <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mfrac><mrow><mi>d</mi><mi>x</mi></mrow><mrow><mi>d</mi><mi>t</mi></mrow></mfrac><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\frac{dx}{dt} = 0</annotation></semantics></math>. At <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>1</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">(1, 1)</annotation></semantics></math> the denominator of <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mfrac><mrow><mi>d</mi><mi>y</mi></mrow><mrow><mi>d</mi><mi>x</mi></mrow></mfrac></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\frac{dy}{dx}</annotation></semantics></math> is <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mn>2</mn><mo>−</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>−</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">2 - 1 - 1 = 0</annotation></semantics></math> and the numerator is <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mo form="prefix" lspace="0" rspace="0">−</mo><mn>3</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">-3</annotation></semantics></math>, so the tangent line there is vertical: the particle is moving straight up at that instant, with no horizontal motion.
